breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent failed to resolve this, instead incorrectly merging the two by stating to 'Employ an explicit forward Euler time integration scheme with Strang splitting'. This does not resolve the conflict and repeats the incorrect instruction.
